title: SIMPLY: Create
description: The perfect Create Mod modpack with all the other additions Minecraft should have
body:
- The perfect Create Mod modpack -

![----------------------------------](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58f740f5d2396aced2c17dbcf1e54c7c177e9f5a.png)

Focused gameplay around the Create Mod
Gameplay changes for an easier starting phase
Just go straight into the automatization and engineering world of create
For those who want to discover the Create Mod
Keeping the essence of the vanilla minecraft experience


![----------------------------------](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58f740f5d2396aced2c17dbcf1e54c7c177e9f5a.png)

Features


This modpack contains over 200 mods, some of the features that this mods inlcudes are:


- **Redefined Structures** - Improved structures loot for a faster start-up. - **Automatization and Engineering** - The Crete Mod introduces a new way to obtain resources. - **Unique Gear** - Discover rare items with special abilities. - **Alternative End** - A fresh take on the End dimension and Ender Dragon fight. - **Quality of Life** - Simplified gameplay with smoother mechanics for daily tasks. - **Performance** - Optimized for minimal lag and a seamless gaming experience.

If you'd like to use these mods for personal enjoyment, please download them from their original sources to support the creators.
